description: This Dart source file defines an ApiClient class responsible for handling HTTP communication with a backend API, including methods for GET, POST, PUT, and DELETE requests. It manages the base URL configuration via environment variables and includes error handling via ApiException. The file also defines the ApiException class used for error signaling.

classes.name: ApiClient
classes.description: Provides methods for making HTTP requests to a backend API, managing URL construction, headers, and error handling.

classes.name: ApiException
classes.description: Custom exception class for indicating errors during API requests.

methods.name: ApiClient
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the HTTP client and determines the base URL from environment variables or defaults.

methods.name: _resolveBaseUrl
methods.description: Static method that retrieves the base URL from environment variables or defaults to local server.

methods.name: _uri
methods.description: Constructs a Uri object from a path and optional query parameters.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Performs a GET request to the specified path with optional query parameters.

methods.name: post
methods.description: Performs a POST request with a JSON-encoded body.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Performs a PUT request with a JSON-encoded body.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Performs a DELETE request to the specified path.

methods.name: _headers
methods.description: Returns the headers used in HTTP requests, including content-type and accept headers.

methods.name: _ensureSuccess
methods.description: Checks if the HTTP response status code indicates success; throws an ApiException otherwise.
